snippet.title: "I Love My Goblin Girlfriend" Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now on itch: https://neddameinna.itch.io/ilmgg

I Love My Goblin Girlfriend is a one-player point-and-click adventure game designed to explore the age-old question: what does your girlfriend want to eat? It’s all about the journey three-part snack adventure! Can you satisfy your goblin girlfriend and unlock the smooch of your dreams? After all, goblin girl’s gotta eat!

Made by Annie Madden, Javi Muhrer and Erik Carter. Music by Marshall Hattersley.
